subject: Long processing for a rowCallback in a renderDataTable

messages.author: 4b829b0eb52afa48
messages.subject: Long processing for a rowCallback in a renderDataTable
parts:
Dear All,

I try to highlight with different colors the lines of my renderDataTable.

I use http://stackoverflow.com/questions/28359626/highlight-rows-in-shiny-datatable-using-callback-or-something-eles as an example. It is very helpfull.

However, in this example, he is looking to know if data[1] == "R" or "E" or "G". For my part, I would like to know if data[1] contain "R", ... (here I use stringr)

I thus coded:
library("stringr")
library(shiny)

ui <- shinyUI(fluidPage(
  sidebarPanel(),
  mainPanel(dataTableOutput("Table"))
))
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  output$Table<- renderDataTable({
    Data<-data.frame(RowNumber= c(1,2,3,4,5,6),Type= c("R_X","E_X", "R_X","E_X","R_X","G_X"), YN =c("N","N","Y","N","Y","N"),P = c(500,100,500,900,0,900))
    Data},
    options = list(rowCallback = I(
      'function(row, data) {
      if (str_detect(data[1],"R") == T)
      $("td", row).css("background", "orange");
      else if (str_detect(data[1],"E") == T)
      $("td", row).css("background", "blue");
      else if (str_detect(data[1],"G") == T)
      $("td", row).css("background", "yellow");
}'
                        ))
    )
  }

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)

But the table is not displayed and a processing is printed on screen.

What is the problem ???
Thank you very much in advance !!

Cheers!

Cha

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Long processing for a rowCallback in a renderDataTable
parts:
You cannot blend R functions into JavaScript. str_detect() is not a
JavaScript function, so it will not work. You may google something
like "JavaScript string matching" for the correct JavaScript method.

Regards,
Yihui
